scientific_limits.en: ["No four-angle realphoto set. Whole specimen plus real head and fin photographs, explicit anatomical ratios, and published estimate support bounded3D reconstruction, not photogrammetry.", "The ROM photo accession is not verified. Scale VP47698 and shape photo are same-species separate evidence, never represented as one measured individual.", "Museum mounts and historical material may be restored; OUM J10305 assessment is specifically favorable, while R498 and BGS51236 are not adopted as exact geometric anchors.", "Dorsal/caudal softfin outlines and bodywidth are unpreserved. Weak tailflexure is required; generic steep lunar tail unsupported.", "Do not use infant CAMSM J35178 proportions from Lomax2012 as adult head/body ratio; paper used for species diagnosis/context only."] {"unit": "metre", "nominal_total_length": 2.56, "status": "published representative estimate, not scan/caliper total", "skull_length_inferred": 0.7, "mandible_length_inferred": 0.69, "snout_to_anterior_orbit_inferred": 0.51, "bony_orbit_diameter_inferred": 0.14, "external_eye_diameter_inferred": 0.055, "forepaddle_length_inferred": 0.36, "hindpaddle_length_inferred": 0.22, "body_width_inferred_range": [0.24, 0.32], "body_depth_inferred_range": [0.32, 0.42], "reason": "Only total2.56m is a published specimen-based length estimate. Other values are bounded original modeling proportions, not measurements of VP47698. McGowan ratios use jaw length: snout>0.70, orbit<0.25 (often<0.20); OUM J10305 snout ratio0.72 and prenarial0.60, with9mm tip ambiguity. Large eye means large relative to short posterior head, NOT giant relative to entire long skull."}
